name: Hound of God (Skinwalker Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
Being a lycanthrope, or having lycanthropic blood, is not necessarily a bad thing. According to some, the deities of night and protection chose these creatures to be the bridge between realms of existence, and protect their flock from fiends and evil magic.

Alignment: A hound of god must have a good alignment.

Judgment

The following judgment works differently for a hound of god:

Smiting

At 10th level, the inquisitor’s weapons count as silver and cold iron instead of adamantine.

Scent Unnaturals (Ex)

At 2nd level, a hound of god gains the scent ability, but only to detect undead and evil outsiders.

This replaces track.

Heavens’ Paw (Ex)

At 5th level, a hound of god gains the celestial template when in her bestial form.

This replaces discern lies.

Improved Heavens’ Paw (Ex)

At 20th level, a hound of god gains the half-celestial template, both in her human and bestial form.

This replaces true judgment.
